locationScope: Shepherd’s Glen Police Station, Alex’s closed cell before release by Wheeler
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Reconstruct only this room's observed architecture, with a deliberate side-on camera adaptation. Remove Alex, Wheeler, every person, creature, weapon, flashlight hotspot, subtitle and HUD. Scene: a small low-ceiling gray-green police holding cell. The main identifiable structure is a closed wall of thin straight gray steel vertical jail bars with two or three narrow horizontal rails and a closed barred door with a modest rectangular metal lock plate, continuing into a dark holding corridor behind it. Preserve the simple closely spaced bars, square metal frames, worn pale concrete/masonry walls, subdued dark lower wall band, rough cracked gray concrete floor and cold restrained illumination visible in the references. Background wall and cage occupy the upper 70 percent. Broad continuous level concrete floor spans the lower 30 percent with an uninterrupted fighter footing line at normalized y=0.87. Keep the central 86 percent empty of props and obstacles. Room is modest and enclosed, with upper wall/ceiling shadow preserving its small scale. Do not invent elaborate unseen rooms; let them fall into darkness.
Materials and palette: realistic worn game-environment bitmap, muted cool charcoal, gray-green concrete, dull silver-blue bars, weak diffuse light. Enough midtone separation to see fighters.
